title: syagrus oleracea var. platyphylla
intro: Syagrus oleracea var. platyphylla, commonly known as the Feijoa, is a plant species native to South America. This plant is valued for its edible fruits, which have been traditionally used for their potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Feijoa include immune system support, anti-cancer and anti-diabetic activities, as well as cardiovascular protection. The bioactive constituents present in Feijoa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
